section: Air pollution - sources, pollutants, NAAQS, AQI, National Clean Air Programme, stubble burning

accepted.s: The National Air Quality Index (NAQI) is published by which organisation?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
accepted.x: The NAQI is published by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).
accepted.tq: Identify the agency responsible for the index.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Air Quality Index covers how many pollutants on a scale of 0–500?
accepted.x: The NAQI covers eight pollutants—PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, CO, O3, NH3 and Pb—on a 0–500 scale.
accepted.tq: Split the options by matching the exact number with the listed components.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the eight pollutants covered by the National Air Quality Index?
accepted.x: Benzene is included in the 12-pollutant NAAQS set, but not among the eight pollutants used in the NAQI list stated here.
accepted.tq: Find the pollutant belonging to the broader NAAQS list rather than the AQI eight.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Air Quality Index:
1. It is expressed on a scale from 0 to 500.
2. It includes PM10 and PM2.5.
3. It is published by the CPCB.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the NAQI uses a 0–500 scale, includes PM10 and PM2.5, and is published by CPCB.
accepted.tq: Use the all-inclusive option only after verifying each statement independently.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: An AQI value of 35 falls under which category and colour?
accepted.x: An AQI of 0–50 is classified as Good and is represented by dark green.
accepted.tq: Place the numerical value within the correct AQI interval before selecting the category.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the AQI category for the range 101–200?
accepted.x: The range 101–200 corresponds to the Moderately polluted category.
accepted.tq: Recall the middle ranges of the AQI classification table.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (AQI range)
 a. 51–100
 b. 201–300
 c. 301–400
 d. 401–500
List-II (Category)
 i. Severe
 ii. Poor
 iii. Satisfactory
 iv. Very poor

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The correct matches are 51–100—Satisfactory, 201–300—Poor, 301–400—Very poor and 401–500—Severe.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and eliminate codes with a mismatched AQI range.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following AQI categories is associated with the colour maroon?
accepted.x: The Severe category, covering AQI values 401–500, is represented by maroon.
accepted.tq: Test the category–colour pair rather than the numerical range alone.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the National Air Quality Index is correct?
o: It was launched under the National Clean Air Programme and implemented by MoES.
It was launched under the Smart Cities Mission and implemented by IMD.
It was launched under the Swachh Bharat Abhiyan and implemented by CPCB.
It was launched under the Namami Gange Programme and implemented by NITI Aayog.
accepted.x: The index was launched in 2015 under the Swachh Bharat Abhiyan and is implemented by CPCB.
accepted.tq: Use the programme–implementing agency association to reject swapped authorities.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The expression “One Number – One Colour – One Description” is associated with which of the following?
accepted.x: “One Number – One Colour – One Description” is the communication principle associated with the AQI.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely related air-quality instruments and programmes.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: How many pollutants are prescribed under the National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS)?
accepted.x: The NAAQS cover 12 pollutants, including the eight AQI pollutants plus benzene, benzo(a)pyrene, arsenic and nickel.
accepted.tq: Compare the broader NAAQS list with the eight-pollutant AQI list.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following pollutants is added to the eight AQI pollutants in the NAAQS list?
1. Benzene
2. Arsenic
3. Nickel
4. Benzo(a)pyrene
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four listed substances—benzene, arsenic, nickel and benzo(a)pyrene—are added to the eight AQI pollutants in the 12-pollutant NAAQS set.
accepted.tq: Check whether the option containing the complete added set is justified.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Ambient Air Quality Standards were notified in 1982 and revised in which years?
accepted.x: The NAAQS were notified in 1982 and revised in 1994 and 2009.
accepted.tq: Retain the sequence of the original notification followed by the two revisions.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which pollutant was included for the first time in the 2009 revision of the National Ambient Air Quality Standards?
accepted.x: Ozone was included for the first time in the 2009 revision of the NAAQS.
accepted.tq: Identify the pollutant linked to the specific revision year.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Air Quality Monitoring Programme (NAMP) was started in which year?
accepted.x: NAMP was started in 1984 by CPCB.
accepted.tq: Separate the monitoring programme’s start year from the NAAQS notification and revision years.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which set of pollutants is regularly monitored under NAMP?
o: Lead, nickel, arsenic and benzo(a)pyrene only
CO, O3, NH3 and benzene only
accepted.x: NAMP regularly monitors SO2, NO2, PM10 and PM2.5.
accepted.tq: Match the monitoring programme with its core pollutant set.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the March 2026 figure, the NAMP network comprises how many stations in how many cities?
accepted.x: The March 2026 figure gives 1,646 stations covering 603 cities.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the latest network figure from earlier monitoring-network figures.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The earlier NAMP network figure of 1,597 stations in 583 cities consisted of how many manual stations and how many CAAQMS stations?
accepted.x: The stated composition is 1,035 manual stations and 562 CAAQMS stations.
accepted.tq: Use the total and component figures together rather than relying on a single number.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which organisation runs SAFAR through IITM, Pune?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
accepted.x: SAFAR is run by the Ministry of Earth Sciences through IITM, Pune.
accepted.tq: Apply the “who runs it?” method to distinguish the ministry from CPCB.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The SAFAR-AIR app is associated with the SAFAR air-quality forecasting system.
accepted.tq: Match each instrument or programme with its specific digital or operational component.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The MoES forecast system associated with Delhi air quality provides forecasts at what resolution and is linked to which response plan?
accepted.x: The MoES system provides forecasts at 400 m resolution and is tied to the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP).
accepted.tq: Pair the exact technical resolution with the associated policy mechanism.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement regarding CAAQMS is correct?
o: It is operated exclusively by industries outside monitoring networks.
Its data are made available through the SAMEER app.
It replaced all manual monitoring stations in the country.
It monitors only sulphur dioxide and nitrogen dioxide.
accepted.x: CAAQMS data are provided through the SAMEER app. CAAQMS also tracks pollutants such as PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NOx, CO, O3, NH3 and benzene.
accepted.tq: Reject absolute claims and identify the precise data-access association.
accepted.sec: AQI and NAAQS - categories, pollutants, NAMP, SAFAR  [APPSC]

accepted.s: How many CAAQM stations and LED display boards are operated by APPCB according to the APSES 2024–25 figures?
accepted.x: APPCB operates 12 CAAQM stations and 19 LED display boards; nine additional stations were being installed.
accepted.tq: Keep the station, board and proposed-addition figures separate.
accepted.sec: AP air quality action  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding air-quality monitoring in Andhra Pradesh:
1. APPCB operates 12 CAAQM stations.
2. Nine additional CAAQM stations were being installed.
3. APPCB operates 25 real-time noise stations.
4. Industries operate 735 CAAQMS across 682 units.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correspond to the stated AP air-quality monitoring figures.
accepted.tq: Verify each numerical statement before selecting the complete combination.
accepted.sec: AP air quality action  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The APPCB state-level action plan covers how many urban local bodies, including how many municipal corporations?
o: 125 urban local bodies including 19 municipal corporations
100 urban local bodies including 12 municipal corporations
135 urban local bodies including 25 municipal corporations
123 urban local bodies including 17 municipal corporations
accepted.x: The action plan covers 123 urban local bodies, including 17 municipal corporations.
accepted.tq: Link the total coverage figure with the embedded municipal-corporation figure.
accepted.sec: AP air quality action  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Burning tyres, plastic and flex during Bhogi can release which of the following pollutants?
1. Dioxins and furans
2. Sulphur dioxide
3. Heavy metals
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The burning of tyres, plastic and flex can release dioxins, furans, sulphur dioxide and heavy metals.
accepted.tq: Recognise the health-related pollutant cluster associated with open burning.
accepted.sec: AP air quality action  [APPSC]

accepted.s: School Eco-Clubs in Andhra Pradesh function under which initiative and have operated since which academic period?
accepted.x: The school Eco-Clubs operate under the AP National Green Corps and have existed since 2002–03.
accepted.tq: Match the awareness mechanism with its parent initiative and starting period.
accepted.sec: AP air quality action  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which combination correctly describes the reported Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2026 result in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Vijayawada Ward 31 ranked second nationally and Ward 60 was best in the State.
Vijayawada Ward 60 ranked second nationally and Ward 31 was best in the State.
Vijayawada Ward 31 ranked second nationally and VMC received ₹19 lakh.
Vijayawada Ward 60 ranked first nationally and Ward 31 ranked second in the State.
accepted.x: Vijayawada Ward 60 ranked second nationally, Ward 31 was best in the State, and VMC received ₹30 lakh.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between two closely related wards and their rankings.
accepted.sec: AP air quality action  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which group of metals is used in catalytic converters?
accepted.x: Catalytic converters use platinum, palladium and rhodium as catalyst metals.
accepted.tq: Recall the characteristic precious-metal trio used in the device.
accepted.sec: Control technologies - catalytic converters, cloud seeding, indoor pollution  [other exams]

accepted.s: A catalytic converter converts carbon monoxide, hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides principally into which products?
accepted.x: The converter changes CO, hydrocarbons and NOx into carbon dioxide, water and nitrogen.
accepted.tq: Follow the pollutant-to-product transformation rather than merely identifying the device.
accepted.sec: Control technologies - catalytic converters, cloud seeding, indoor pollution  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Which of the following substances may be used in cloud seeding?
1. Silver iodide
2. Potassium iodide
3. Dry ice
4. Common salt
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Cloud seeding may use silver iodide, potassium iodide, dry ice and common salt.
accepted.tq: Check the complete list of recognised cloud-seeding agents.
accepted.sec: Control technologies - catalytic converters, cloud seeding, indoor pollution  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT listed as an air-pollution control technology?
accepted.x: Scrubbers, electrostatic precipitators and FGD are pollution-control technologies; pelletisation is an ex-situ method of managing crop residue.
accepted.tq: Separate stationary-source pollution controls from crop-residue management methods.
accepted.sec: Control technologies - catalytic converters, cloud seeding, indoor pollution  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which emission standard became applicable from 1 April 2020?
accepted.x: BS-VI emission standards became applicable from 1 April 2020.
accepted.tq: Associate the exact implementation date with the correct standards stage.
accepted.sec: Control technologies - catalytic converters, cloud seeding, indoor pollution  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is a recognised source of indoor air pollution?
o: Only dissolved salts in drinking water
accepted.x: Indoor air pollution can arise from smoke from solid fuels, dust, mould, pollen, radon and carbon monoxide.
accepted.tq: Identify the realistic indoor source and reject unrelated environmental factors.
accepted.sec: Control technologies - catalytic converters, cloud seeding, indoor pollution  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Indoor air pollution is associated with which of the following health conditions?
1. Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
2. Lung cancer
3. Improved pulmonary function
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Indoor air pollution is linked to COPD and lung cancer; it does not improve pulmonary function.
accepted.tq: Spot the reversed health effect in the third statement.
accepted.sec: Control technologies - catalytic converters, cloud seeding, indoor pollution  [other exams]

accepted.s: Lichens are particularly useful as bioindicators of pollution by which pollutant?
accepted.x: Lichens indicate sulphur dioxide pollution and disappear from areas with high SO2 levels.
accepted.tq: Use the organism–pollutant association central to bioindicator questions.
accepted.sec: Bioindicators - lichens  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about lichens and mosses:
1. Lichens disappear from areas with high SO2 pollution.
2. Mosses accumulate heavy metals.
3. Mosses can indicate the deposition of heavy metals.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: lichens are sensitive to SO2, while mosses accumulate and indicate heavy-metal deposition.
accepted.tq: Compare the two bioindicator organisms before choosing the combined option.
accepted.sec: Bioindicators - lichens  [other exams]

accepted.s: Stubble burning after paddy and wheat harvest is especially associated with which months and states?
o: July–August in Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka
October–November in Punjab, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh
April–May in Rajasthan, Gujarat and Maharashtra
January–February in Bihar, Jharkhand and Odisha
accepted.x: Paddy and wheat stubble is mainly burnt during October–November in Punjab, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Combine the seasonal and geographical clues to identify the correct pair.
accepted.sec: Stubble burning and NCR measures - CAQM, decomposer, machinery, GRAP  [other exams]

accepted.s: The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) was first set up through which instrument?
accepted.x: CAQM was initially set up through an Ordinance in 2020 and was subsequently established under the CAQM Act, 2021.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the temporary initiating instrument from the later statutory Act.
accepted.sec: Stubble burning and NCR measures - CAQM, decomposer, machinery, GRAP  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding CAQM is correct?
o: Its chairperson has the rank of a district collector and a fixed tenure of ten years.
It was constituted only after the CAQM Act of 2021 and had no ordinance stage.
It can issue advisory reports but cannot shut down violating units.
Its chairperson has the rank of Secretary or Chief Secretary, with a three-year tenure or age limit of 70 years.
accepted.x: The CAQM chairperson has the rank of Secretary or Chief Secretary, with a tenure of three years or up to the age of 70 years; CAQM can shut down violators.
accepted.tq: Check authority, tenure and power together while rejecting the absolute limitation.
accepted.sec: Stubble burning and NCR measures - CAQM, decomposer, machinery, GRAP  [other exams]

accepted.s: The Pusa bio-decomposer used for crop-residue management was developed by which institution?
accepted.x: The Pusa bio-decomposer is associated with the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI).
accepted.tq: Match the named technology with its developing institution.
accepted.sec: Stubble burning and NCR measures - CAQM, decomposer, machinery, GRAP  [other exams]

accepted.s: The Central Sector Scheme on in-situ crop-residue management machinery was started in which year?
accepted.x: The scheme supporting in-situ crop-residue management machinery started in 2018.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the scheme’s starting year from later air-quality measures.
accepted.sec: Stubble burning and NCR measures - CAQM, decomposer, machinery, GRAP  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following is an ex-situ method of managing crop residue?
o: Leaving residue in the field for decomposition
accepted.x: Pelletisation is an ex-situ method; torrefaction, briquetting and co-firing are also listed as ex-situ approaches.
accepted.tq: Separate in-situ field treatment from ex-situ processing of collected residue.
accepted.sec: Stubble burning and NCR measures - CAQM, decomposer, machinery, GRAP  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (GRAP stage)
 a. Stage I
 b. Stage II
 c. Stage III
 d. Stage IV
List-II (AQI trigger)
 i. Severe+ above 450
 ii. Poor, 201–300
 iii. Severe, 401–450
 iv. Very poor, 301–400

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: GRAP Stage I corresponds to Poor, Stage II to Very poor, Stage III to Severe (401–450), and Stage IV to Severe+ above 450.
accepted.tq: Start with Stage I and Stage IV, then resolve the middle stages by AQI range.
accepted.sec: Stubble burning and NCR measures - CAQM, decomposer, machinery, GRAP  [other exams]

accepted.s: Coal was banned for industrial and domestic use in Delhi-NCR from which date?
accepted.x: Coal use in industries and homes in Delhi-NCR was banned from 1 January 2023.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact effective date of the NCR coal restriction.
accepted.sec: Stubble burning and NCR measures - CAQM, decomposer, machinery, GRAP  [other exams]

accepted.s: In 2025–26, Bihar suspended DBT registration in connection with stubble burning for how many farmers?
accepted.x: Bihar suspended the DBT registration of 1,807 farmers for stubble burning during 2025–26.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the enforcement figure from nearby monitoring-network numbers.
accepted.sec: Stubble burning and NCR measures - CAQM, decomposer, machinery, GRAP  [other exams]
